description: Voting commands: create, edit, delete draft, open, cast, close, conclude.
precondition: Meeting in a voting status; chair or manager actor.

preconditions: Meeting the actor cannot read (not organizer, approver or participant).
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 MSG205; nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor's account is deactivated.
cases.return: Failure Inactive; 403 with no message code; nothing saved.

preconditions: Guest actor whose invitation is revoked or whose session is invalid.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 MSG205.

preconditions: Guest actor whose session belongs to another meeting.
cases.inputs: operation: Cast; actor: Guest of a different meeting.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 MSG205.

preconditions: Guest actor with a verified session; meeting Ended (a Guest loses access once the meeting ends).
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 MSG205.

preconditions: Draft vote; actor is an ordinary Member who can read the meeting.
cases.inputs: operation: Update; voteId: the draft; actor: Member.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 MSG205, as if the draft did not exist.

preconditions: No vote with that id in the meeting.
cases.inputs: operation: Close; voteId: unknown id; actor: Chair.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 MSG205.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: false.
cases.return: Success; VoteId of the new Draft vote; options saved at positions 1 and 2; MSG210.
cases.log: Draft vote row with creator = actor; DraftCreated event published to Chair and Secretary only.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "  Họp  " (spaces trimmed to "Họp"); Options: [" A ", "B"]; IsAnonymous: true; EligibleRoles: ["Guest"].
cases.return: Success; MSG210; title saved as "Họp", options "A" and "B", secret ballot, roles [Guest].
cases.log: Draft saved; DraftCreated event to managers only.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is a Member.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"].
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213.

preconditions: Meeting Ended; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"].
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213.

preconditions: Meeting Draft (not yet approved); actor is the Secretary.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"].
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: ""; Options: ["A"]; IsAnonymous: null; EligibleRoles: [].
cases.return: Failure Invalid; 400 MSG209 with errors for title, options, isAnonymous and eligibleRoles; nothing saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; request sent with a non-JSON content type (ParseFailure UnsupportedMedia).
cases.return: Failure UnsupportedMedia; 415 MSG34.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; body over 64 KiB (ParseFailure TooLarge).
cases.return: Failure TooLarge; 413 MSG87.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the Secretary.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: true.
cases.return: Failure OpenDenied; 409 MSG218; no draft is left behind.

preconditions: Meeting Published; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: true.
cases.return: Failure OpenDenied; 409 MSG218 (opening needs InProgress).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; another vote is already Open.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: true.
cases.return: Failure AnotherOpen; 409 MSG219; nothing saved.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; no other vote open; Chair and Member are active participants.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: true.
cases.return: Success; MSG217; the new vote is Open with EligibleCount 2 and OpenedAt = now.
cases.log: Vote and its two eligible-voter rows saved; Opened event (with the title) published to everyone.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; the selected role has no holder.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; EligibleRoles: ["Guest"]; OpenImmediately: true; no Guest invited.
cases.return: Failure NoEligibleVoters; 409 MSG220; no draft is left behind.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG214; nothing saved.
cases.log: Error logged with the operation and meeting id.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; the other Open vote is created by a simultaneous request.
cases.inputs: operation: Create with OpenImmediately: true; the database's one-open-vote index rejects the save.
cases.return: Failure AnotherOpen; 409 MSG219; changes discarded.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote with options ["A", "B", "C"]; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Update; Title: "Mới"; Options: ["A", "B2"]; IsAnonymous: true; EligibleRoles: ["Member"].
cases.return: Success; MSG211; option 2 relabelled, option 3 removed; new title, secret ballot and roles kept.
cases.log: Draft updated; DraftUpdated event to managers only.

preconditions: Draft vote with options ["A", "B"].
cases.return: Success; MSG211; a third option is added at position 3.

preconditions: Vote is Open; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: Update; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"].
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213; the vote is unchanged.

preconditions: Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure Invalid; 400 MSG209 with errors[options]; draft unchanged.

preconditions: Draft vote; actor is the Secretary; meeting InProgress.
cases.inputs: operation: Update; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: true.
cases.return: Failure OpenDenied; 409 MSG218; draft keeps its previous content.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; draft vote; no other vote open.
cases.inputs: operation: Update; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: true.
cases.return: Success; MSG217; vote saved with the edits and Opened.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; draft vote; selected roles have no holder.
cases.return: Failure NoEligibleVoters; 409 MSG220; the saved draft stays as it was.

preconditions: Meeting Published; Draft vote; actor is the Secretary.
cases.return: Success; MSG212; the draft, its options and links are removed.

preconditions: Vote is Open.
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213; the vote stays.

preconditions: Vote is Closed.
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213; the vote stays as evidence.

preconditions: Draft vote; meeting Ended.
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213.

preconditions: Draft vote; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG216; the draft stays.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; Draft vote with roles [Chair, Member]; both active.
cases.return: Success; MSG217; status Open, OpenedAt = now, EligibleCount 2 and the two voters stored.
cases.log: Opened event with title published to everyone.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; Draft vote with roles [Guest]; one invited Guest with a live invitation.
cases.return: Success; EligibleCount 1 (the invitation); MSG217.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; vote roles [Member, Guest]; 2 active Members and 1 Guest invitation.
cases.return: Success; EligibleCount 3; voters = both users plus the invitation.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Draft vote; actor is the Secretary.
cases.return: Failure OpenDenied; 409 MSG218.

preconditions: Meeting Published; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure OpenDenied; 409 MSG218.

preconditions: Vote already Open; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure OpenDenied; 409 MSG218.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; another vote of the meeting is Open.
cases.inputs: operation: Open on a Draft vote.
cases.return: Failure AnotherOpen; 409 MSG219.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; vote roles [Secretary] but the Secretary is deactivated.
cases.return: Failure NoEligibleVoters; 409 MSG220; vote stays Draft.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; Draft vote.
cases.inputs: operation: Open; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG221; vote stays Draft.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; two Chair requests open different drafts at once.
cases.inputs: operation: Open; the database's one-open-vote index rejects the second save.
cases.return: Failure AnotherOpen; 409 MSG219; second request's changes discarded.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; public ballot; no vote documents.
cases.return: Success; MSG227; one receipt and one choice stored for the voter; option A count +1.
cases.log: Ballot saved; BallotCast event published (never names the voter).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; secret ballot.
cases.return: Success; MSG227; a receipt is stored but no row says what the voter chose; option B count +1.

preconditions: Guest with a verified session on an Open vote listing the Guest invitation; meeting InProgress.
cases.inputs: operation: Cast; actor: Guest; OptionId: option A.
cases.return: Success; MSG227; receipt and choice are stored against the guest invitation.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote; actor was not on the list fixed at opening (joined later).
cases.return: Failure NotEligible; 409 MSG224.

preconditions: Vote Closed; actor is on the eligible list.
cases.return: Failure NotAccepting; 409 MSG225.

preconditions: Open vote but the meeting has Ended; actor eligible.
cases.return: Failure NotAccepting; 409 MSG225.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; the voter already cast a ballot.
cases.return: Failure AlreadyCast; 409 MSG226; the first ballot stands.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; two ballots from the same voter arrive at once.
cases.return: The second gets Failure AlreadyCast; 409 MSG226; its changes discarded.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; the vote has two documents, the voter confirmed only one.
cases.return: Failure DocumentsUnread; 409 MSG252 listing the one unread document; no ballot stored.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; the vote's only unread document was removed from the meeting.
cases.return: Success; MSG227; a removed document no longer counts.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list.
cases.return: Failure OptionMissing; 400 MSG222.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list.
cases.return: Failure OptionMissing; 400 MSG222.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list.
cases.inputs: operation: Cast; OptionId: an option id of another vote.
cases.return: Failure OptionUnavailable; 400 MSG223; no ballot stored.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list.
cases.inputs: operation: Cast; non-JSON content type (ParseFailure UnsupportedMedia).
cases.return: Failure UnsupportedMedia; 415 MSG34.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list.
cases.inputs: operation: Cast; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG228; no ballot recorded.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with 3 ballots; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Success; MSG229; status Closed, ClosedAt = now; the result (ballot count and per-option counts and percentages) is returned.

preconditions: Meeting Ended; Open vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Success; MSG229; closing is still allowed after the meeting ended.

preconditions: Open vote with no ballots.
cases.return: Success; MSG229; counts are 0 and percentages are not shown (null).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote; actor is the Secretary.
cases.return: Failure CloseDenied; 409 MSG230.

preconditions: Vote is Draft or already Closed; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure CloseDenied; 409 MSG230.

preconditions: Meeting Cancelled; vote Open; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure CloseDenied; 409 MSG230.

preconditions: Open vote; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG231; the vote stays Open with its ballots.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.inputs: operation: Conclude (RecordConclusion); Conclusion: "Passed"; Note: "  Thống nhất  ".
cases.return: Success; MSG235; conclusion Passed, note "Thống nhất", concluded by the Chair at now.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.inputs: operation: Conclude; Conclusion: "Deferred"; Note with 2000 characters.
cases.return: Success; MSG235; the 2000-character note is kept.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.return: Success; MSG235; note stored as an empty string.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.return: Failure ConclusionInvalid; 400 MSG232 with errors[conclusion].

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.return: Failure ConclusionInvalid; 400 MSG232 with errors[note].

preconditions: Closed vote that already has a conclusion.
cases.return: Failure ConclusionRecorded; 409 MSG233; the first conclusion stays.

preconditions: Vote still Open.
cases.return: Failure ConclusionDenied; 409 MSG234.

preconditions: Closed vote; actor is the Secretary.
cases.return: Failure ConclusionDenied; 409 MSG234.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.inputs: operation: Conclude; non-JSON content type (ParseFailure UnsupportedMedia).
cases.return: Failure UnsupportedMedia; 415 MSG34.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.inputs: operation: Conclude; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG236; no conclusion recorded.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; two meeting documents not yet attached.
cases.return: Success; MSG265; both documents attached; no new meeting document added.
cases.log: Two vote-document links saved; DocumentsChanged event to managers only.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; one document.
cases.return: Success; the duplicate is collapsed and one link is created.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure DocumentNotInMeeting; 404 MSG170.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: AttachDocuments; DocumentIds: [a document of another meeting].
cases.return: Failure DocumentNotInMeeting; 404 MSG170; nothing attached.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; doc1 is already attached.
cases.return: Failure DocumentAlreadyAttached; 409 MSG266; none is attached (all or none).

preconditions: Vote is Open; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213; the document list is fixed once the vote opens.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: AttachDocuments; non-JSON content type (ParseFailure UnsupportedMedia).
cases.return: Failure UnsupportedMedia; 415 MSG34.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: AttachDocuments; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG267; nothing attached.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; the actor's library holds two documents.
cases.return: Success; MSG265; both are added to the meeting and attached in the same save; the added documents are returned.
cases.log: Meeting documents and vote links saved together.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: AttachFromLibrary; DocumentIds: [a library document of someone else].
cases.return: Failure LibraryUnavailable; 400 MSG249; nothing added.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; the library document is already attached to this vote.
cases.return: Failure DocumentAlreadyAttached; 409 MSG266.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: AttachFromLibrary; adding fails for any other reason.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG166; no document added.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; doc1 attached to the draft and to an agenda item.
cases.return: Success; MSG268; only the vote link is removed; the document stays in the meeting.
cases.log: Link row removed; DocumentsChanged event to managers only.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair; doc2 is not attached.
cases.return: Failure DocumentNotAttached; 404 MSG269.

preconditions: Vote is Open; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Failure DraftDenied; 409 MSG213.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; Draft vote; actor is the Chair.
cases.inputs: operation: DetachDocument; the database fails on save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG270; the link stays.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; actor is the current Chair; the real-time push of the change fails or times out after 2 seconds.
cases.return: Success as normal; the committed write is not rolled back.
cases.log: Warning logged: vote committed, realtime delivery failed.
